{
  "analysis": "The screen remains black across multiple QEMU 8.2.2 configurations. The MBR looks valid (boot signature 55AA, FAT16 partition type 0x06 starting at sector 63). Since the task states QEMU 5.2.0 compatibility, we may need that version. But first, let's inspect the disk contents and check if the CPU is actually executing by querying registers and capturing serial output.",
  "plan": "Mount the image to see the DOS/Windows files. Restart QEMU with serial logging to capture any output. Query the monitor for CPU registers to verify code execution. This will help diagnose whether it's a VGA display issue or a boot issue.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "mkdir -p /mnt/win311 && mount -o loop,ro,offset=32256 /app/isos/win311.img /mnt/win311 2>/dev/null && echo "=== Root directory ===" && ls -la /mnt/win311/ && echo "=== Windows dir ===" && ls -la /mnt/win311/windows/ 2>/dev/null | head -30 || echo "Mount failed, trying with losetup"
",
      "duration": 0.1
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "kill $(cat /tmp/qemu.pid) 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; rm -f /tmp/qemu-monitor.sock /tmp/qemu.pid /tmp/qemu-serial.log
qemu-system-i386 \
  -M pc \
  -hda /app/isos/win311.img \
  -snapshot \
  -m 32 \
  -vga std \
  -rtc base=localtime \
  -boot c \
  -serial file:/tmp/qemu-serial.log \
  -vnc :1 \
  -monitor unix:/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock,server,nowait \
  -daemonize \
  -pidfile /tmp/qemu.pid
sleep 5
python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import socket, time
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect('/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock')
time.sleep(0.3)
s.recv(4096)
s.sendall(b'info registers\n')
time.sleep(0.3)
print("=== Registers ===")
print(s.recv(8192).decode(errors='replace'))
s.sendall(b'info status\n')
time.sleep(0.3)
print("=== Status ===")
print(s.recv(4096).decode(errors='replace'))
s.close()
PYEOF
echo "=== Serial log ==="; cat /tmp/qemu-serial.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(empty or missing)"
",
      "duration": 10.0
    }
  ]
}
